approvals.rationale: Residency confirmed with the vendor's DPO in writing; hosting moves to the EU region.

controls.title: MFA enforced for privileged and remote access
Least privilege with periodic access reviews
Encryption at rest and in transit
Current independent assurance (SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001)
No unremediated material incident in 24 months
Data residency or lawful transfer mechanism
No unmitigated exposure to known-exploited vulnerabilities

evidence_required: SOC 2 Type II report summary issued ≤ 12 months before as_of
or ISO 27001 certificate with expires_on ≥ as_of
Declared components checked against CISA KEV
or critical patch SLA ≤ 14 days with attestation
